act.name: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
act.source_authority: Ministry of Education, Government of India
act.description: Central law providing free and compulsory elementary education and protecting children in schools.

sections.title: Right of child to free and compulsory education.
sections.text: Section 3 recognizes the right of every child in the covered age group to free and compulsory elementary education.
sections.plain_language_summary: Children aged six to fourteen have the statutory right to free and compulsory elementary education.

sections.title: Extent of school’s responsibility for free and compulsory education.
sections.text: Section 12 defines the responsibility of specified schools to provide free and compulsory education.
sections.plain_language_summary: Sets school obligations, including the statutory admission responsibility applicable to specified schools.

sections.title: Prohibition of physical punishment and mental harassment to child.
sections.text: Section 17 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment of a child.
sections.plain_language_summary: Schools cannot subject a child to physical punishment or mental harassment.

sections.title: Redressal of grievances.
sections.text: Section 32 provides a grievance-redress mechanism for a child's right under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: A complaint about violation of a child's RTE rights can be made through the statutory grievance process.
